pages.title: Reverse Osmosis Cell
pages.text: A membrane water can pass and salt cannot - if it is pushed harder than osmosis pulls back.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the feed pressure. Water only passes when pushed harder than the osmotic pressure, π = iMRT; the harder, the more. The membrane is rated to 80 bar.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 2 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Concentrated Brine, Water.
